name: tw-server
description: Dev server for Twine/SugarCube stories: builds with tweego, type-checks the story's TypeScript (including code in passages), and live-reloads the browser on change.
//os: The bundled tweego is a Windows binary (dist/tweego/tweego.exe) and it is the only one shipped, so the build cannot run anywhere else. Declaring this makes npm refuse to install on other platforms, which is a clear error instead of a confusing one at first build. Drop this once binaries for darwin/linux are bundled.
author: pelosis-big-knockers
